subject: MAP draft — acceptance scaffold & smoke/regression tests for evaluation

Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@curasense.com>

Subject: MAP draft — acceptance scaffold & smoke/regression tests for evaluation

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. I attached an initial MAP (acceptance scaffold) and a lightweight test vector pack to make the evaluation concrete. High-level proposal and asks below so we can lock a short, evidence-driven run: 

Key success criteria (proposal)
- Functional concordance: labeled evaluation set concordance >= 90% for the top-1 classification/intent bucket.
- Observability: end-to-end tracing + token-level latency sampling with 95th percentile < 250ms for single-request profile.
- Recall/embedding quality: retrieval recall @k=10 >= 0.92 using our similarity metric (same seed vectors provided).
- Stability: no more than 2 regressions (conceived as critical slip in concordance) across 1,000 randomized runs.

Exit gates (what must pass to be considered ‘green’)
- Smoke suite (owner: Redwood) passes on customer staging for 3 consecutive days.
- Evidence artifact: test vector results, logs, and a brief variance analysis doc submitted to procurement/security.
- Rollback plan reviewed and acknowledged by CuraSense ops.

Acceptance tests (examples)
- Deterministic test vectors (attached) — pass/fail thresholds on precision/recall.
- Latency sweep (50–1k concurrent synthetic users) — verify p95 and error rates.
- Fault injection (network throttling) — validate graceful degradation and fallback to smaller model variant.

Proposed near-term timeline (draft)
- Week 0 (this week): finalize MAP owners and provide security pack.
- Week 1: staging deployment + integration of tracing hooks.
- Week 2: smoke and regression runs; evidence collection.
- Week 3: parallel-run with production traffic mirror and final acceptance review.

Asks from your side: please confirm the procurement evidence list you need (SOC2, runbook, contract language) and whether the above KPIs align with your internal acceptance thresholds. If the timeline looks OK we’ll create calendar blocks for the acceptance review week.

Attachments: CuraSense_MAP_v0.1.xlsx, acceptance-test-vectors.zip

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com
